name: bloom-skill-evals
description: Promptfoo evaluations of the Bloom agent skill in skills/bloom.

scripts.eval:models: BLOOM_EVAL_MODEL_SUITE=expanded PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo eval --no-cache --repeat 5 --config promptfooconfig.ts --output results/latest-models.json
scripts.eval:claude: BLOOM_EVAL_MODEL_SUITE=claude-revisions BLOOM_EVAL_LOCAL=claude PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo eval --no-cache --repeat 5 --config promptfooconfig.ts --output results/latest-claude.json
scripts.check: node providers/agent-cli.test.mjs && node assertions/onboarding-fixtures.cjs && node assertions/tempdir-fixtures.cjs && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo validate config --config promptfooconfig.ts && BLOOM_EVAL_MODEL_SUITE=expanded PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo validate config --config promptfooconfig.ts && BLOOM_EVAL_MODEL_SUITE=claude-revisions BLOOM_EVAL_LOCAL=claude PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo validate config --config promptfooconfig.ts
